answer: Random peer audit guards a narrow inlet like a velvet rope: each agent posts a 50 POA bond to enter. Each epoch a beacon picks 5 percent at random; three peers re-check their work, and verdicts are etched on a marble tablet. A fake that fails loses bond and identity. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 POA, and 5 burn per epoch, so a fake farm bleeds 250 POA per epoch. An honest agent pays once, passes easily, and keeps its rewards undiluted.
